title: Few-for-Many Best-Arm Identification in Multi-Objective Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2610.16840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world systems often serve many objectives but can deploy only a few options, whose performance must be learned from noisy feedback. Modeling each option as an arm in a multi-objective bandit, we introduce \emph{few-for-many best-arm identification}, which seeks a small set of arms minimizing the worst weighted degradation from the objective-wise optima, rather than the best arm for every objective. We consider both known objective groups and latent groups specified only by a representative budget, and propose \textsc{GFM-Elim} and \textsc{AFM-Elim} with instance-dependent sample-complexity guarantees. For Gaussian rewards, we further derive a lower bound for the latent-group setting and show that it is asymptotically attainable with high probability by an oracle-based Track-and-Stop procedure. translated_title: 多目标老虎机中的“以少应多”最优臂识别
translated_abstract: 现实世界系统往往需要服务多个目标，但只能部署少数选项，而这些选项的性能必须从带噪声的反馈中学习。我们将每个选项建模为多目标老虎机中的一个臂，提出了“以少应多”最优臂识别这一新问题，其目标是寻找一个小型臂集合，使其相对于各目标最优值的最坏加权损失最小化，而不是为每个目标单独找出最优臂。我们同时考虑了已知目标分组和仅由代表性预算刻画的潜在分组两种设定，并提出了GFM-Elim和AFM-Elim两个算法，均具有依赖实例的样本复杂度保证。对于高斯奖励情形，我们进一步推导了潜在分组设定下的样本复杂度下界，并证明通过基于预言机的Track-and-Stop过程可以以高概率渐近达到该下界。我们的结果表明，跨目标共享观测信息并忽略目标之间无关的差异，可以显著降低学习所需的样本成本。
tldr: 该论文提出了多目标老虎机中“以少应多”最优臂识别这一新问题，并设计了GFM-Elim与AFM-Elim算法，通过跨目标共享观测并忽略无关的目标间差异，在样本复杂度保证下找到能最小化最坏加权损失的小型臂集合。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the few-for-many best-arm identification problem in multi-objective bandits and proposes the GFM-Elim and AFM-Elim algorithms with instance-dependent sample-complexity guarantees, showing that sharing observations across objectives and ignoring irrelevant objective-wise distinctions substantially reduces the learning cost.
